hits.title: AMENDMENT TO EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT - RealDealDocs
hits.snippet: This SEC filing details an amendment to the employment agreement between Xometry, Inc. and Sanjeev Singh Sahni, effective July 1, 2026. Under this amendment, Sahni will transition to the role of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and will also serve on the Company’s Board of Directors. His annual base salary will be set at $600,000, with the potential for an annual performance bonus of up to 100% of his base salary, contingent upon meeting performance goals established by the Board. The amendment also specifies that Sahni's eligibility for bonuses is dependent on his status as an employee in good standing at the time of payment. Significantly, the amendment modifies severance provisions, extending the severance pay period from twelve to eighteen months and introducing a cash payment equivalent to one-and-a-half times the target annual bonus upon termination. Additionally, Sahni is entitled to a one-time cash award of $400,000, payable in December 2026, subject to repayment if he resigns without good reason or is terminated for cause within twelve months of his CEO start date.
